recipe.name: Phrynosoma — the horned crown / investment / Silver 925
recipe.calibration_note: Limits inherited from this design; choose a sand recipe to replace them

manufacturing.bench_notes: Factory 004 Shield, poured in lost wax. The table is a horned lizard's skull: cephalic plates cut in three tiers, the comb of six horns on the flat back edge, a jaw fringe down the tapering sides to the snout at the shield's point. Feed from the palm; invest horn tips up. At the bench: tack and file any short-filled horn tip; polish the plates' tops and the horns, leave the joints, granules and fringe satin.

recipe.op: horned lizard head and its ground
